rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together by writing a narrow, harmonizing opinion that treats the adjutant general as the employing instrumentality only for the federally created dual-status technician employment relationship and cabins FLRA authority to civilian conditions of employment. Thomas and/or Alito are likely to write separately to press the § 7103 “agency” text and Hancock clear-statement objection, while one or more textualist members of the majority (especially Barrett or Kagan) may add a concurrence to emphasize the limiting principle and avoidance of militia-command spillover.
